source_method: Official public sources only; authenticated APIs documented but not called; provider checkers treated as network-specific signals
tracks: Openreach and CityFibre provider-specific address states
OS Places UPRN, lifecycle and match-quality controls

sources.name: Ofcom broadband and mobile coverage checker
facts: Checker results are based on predicted broadband availability and speeds supplied by network operators
Actual service availability at a property and speeds received may differ
An amber result can mean a service category is available to some but not all properties in the area
sources.access_guard: Retain the selected address, query time and predicted status; never convert a postcode-area icon into parcel-level certainty.
sources.limitation: The checker is consumer guidance, not proof of installation, provider order acceptance or a legal parcel-to-premises relationship.
sources.access_and_licence: Official Ofcom checker; terms of use apply

sources.name: Openreach fibre broadband availability checker
facts: Checker requires postcode followed by address selection
Available to order now is distinct from available soon, building now and planned states
Openreach states the checker is linked to its network records and updated regularly
sources.access_guard: Only the address-specific Available to order now state may be treated as an Openreach-network signal, and retailer confirmation is still required.
sources.limitation: Openreach covers its own wholesale network only; its checker cannot establish serviceability on other networks or completed retail installation.

sources.name: Openreach fibre availability and build-plan guidance
facts: Build plans can change because of feasibility, permissions and network constraints
Some postcodes can map to more than one cabinet or directly to an exchange
An accepting-orders result still requires ordering through a broadband provider
sources.access_guard: Store current availability separately from planned-build states and preserve the address, network and observation date.
sources.limitation: Street or cabinet proximity cannot be expanded to every property in a postcode or parcel.

sources.name: CityFibre availability checker result guidance
facts: CityFibre directs users to its address checker for property-specific readiness
Street construction does not necessarily mean an individual property is ready to order
Activation can depend on testing, issue resolution and broadband-provider onboarding
sources.access_guard: Treat CityFibre status as provider-specific and retain ready-to-connect separately from street-build or interest-registration states.
sources.limitation: A nearby CityFibre build is not proof of active service at a selected property or another provider's network.
sources.access_and_licence: Official CityFibre help and checker pages

sources.name: OS Places API product overview
sources.published_or_updated: Official documentation verified 31 July 2026; daily update claim
facts: API contains AddressBase Premium address records from creation to retirement
Includes current, alternative, provisional and historic address information
OS states the service is updated daily and does not support bulk queries
sources.access_guard: No API project or key was created; open downloadable identifiers remain preferred for unattended bulk work.
sources.limitation: An authoritative address result or UPRN is not a title boundary or broadband serviceability record.
sources.access_and_licence: Official OS API documentation; authentication and product terms apply

sources.name: OS Places API UPRN endpoint
facts: Endpoint returns matched addresses for a supplied valid UPRN
Response header includes epoch and last-update metadata
Filters can restrict classification, logical status, LPI status and country
sources.access_guard: Require API authentication and retain epoch, dataset, logical status and requested coordinate system in any future audit.
sources.limitation: A successful UPRN lookup confirms an address record, not parcel equivalence, network coverage or order acceptance.
sources.access_and_licence: Official OS API documentation; API key or OAuth2 required

sources.name: OS address datasets and match-quality semantics
facts: DPA is a Royal Mail PAF-matched delivery-point address and not every property record has a DPA
Address status can be Approved, Alternative, Provisional or Historical
Find matching describes exact, good and partial score bands, with extra unmatched input potentially ignored for an exact result
sources.access_guard: An automatic bind must require approved/current status and an explicit match-quality threshold plus review of ignored or conflicting components.
sources.limitation: A high textual match score cannot prove a title-polygon relationship or broadband availability.
sources.access_and_licence: Official OS API documentation; related product terms apply

sources.name: OS Match and Cleanse API end-of-life notice
facts: OS withdrew Match and Cleanse API on 31 March 2026
The retired API did not support bulk processing
Rate limits made it unsuitable for large-batch UPRN linking
sources.access_guard: Do not implement or retry the retired endpoint; use supported current products or documented bulk alternatives.
sources.limitation: Historic documentation cannot be treated as a live production source.

sources.name: Ofcom broadband Universal Service Obligation guidance
facts: A decent connection is at least 10 Mbit/s download and 1 Mbit/s upload
Eligible premises may request an upgraded connection from BT or KCOM in the Hull area
Eligibility is conditional and can be disputed
sources.access_guard: Store USO eligibility or request status separately from measured availability and provider orderability.
sources.limitation: A legal right to request a connection is not evidence that a connection already exists or can be ordered immediately.

sources.name: July 2026 Project Gigabit contracted and built premises
facts: Publication is contract-level and rounded to the nearest 10
Contracted scope may omit deferred-scope premises
BDUK warns of variable lag between delivery and data ingestion and says figures should not assess contractual milestones
sources.access_guard: Keep contract aggregates separate from UPRN-level availability and retain snapshot date, rounding and revision status.
sources.limitation: A built-premises aggregate cannot identify which parcel is connected, currently orderable or included after scope changes.
sources.access_and_licence: Official GOV.UK publication under Open Government Licence
